1909 is not a leap year (1900 multiples of 100 not leap unless divisible by 400).  
28 weeks = 28 × 7 = 196 days.  
Add 5 days → total subtract 201 days.  

Start: 1909-09-05.  
September: 5 days gone, so go back 5 days → August 31.  
Remaining 196 days to go back.  

1909: Jan–Aug 31: 31+28+31+30+31+30+31+31 = 243 days in year before Sep.  
From Aug 31, back 243 days → Jan 1, 1909.  
196 – 243 = –47 means we went too far: actually go back 196 days from Aug 31:  
Aug 31 → Aug 1 is 30 days back (to Aug 1) → 166 left.  
July (31), June (30), May (31), April (30), March (31) = 153 days back → 13 days left.  
From March 1, back 13 days → Feb 16, 1909.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1909-02-16
